passages.text: At the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the LORD: “This is what the LORD says: Stand in the courtyard of the house of the LORD and speak all the words I have commanded you to speak to all the cities of Judah who come to worship there. Do not omit a word.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was the son of Josiah.
Jehoiakim became king of Judah.
At the beginning of Jehoiakim’s reign, the LORD spoke.
The LORD gave a message.
The LORD said these words.
“Stand in the courtyard of the house of the LORD.
Speak to all the cities of Judah.
These people come to worship in the house of the LORD.
Say everything I have commanded you to say to them.
Do not leave out a single word.”
passages.original: בְּרֵאשִׁ֗ית מַמְלְכ֛וּת יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָה֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עֲמֹד֮ בַּחֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֒ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֞ עַל־ כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה הַבָּאִים֙ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖יךָ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם אַל־ תִּגְרַ֖ע דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: Perhaps they will listen and turn—each from his evil way of life—so that I may relent of the disaster I am planning to bring upon them because of the evil of their deeds.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah at the beginning of King Jehoiakim’s reign.
God sent Jeremiah to warn the people of Judah.
God hoped the people would listen.
Each person lived in an evil way.
God wanted each person to turn from his evil way.
If they listened and turned, God would change His mind.
God planned to bring disaster on them.
God planned this disaster because of their evil deeds.
If they turned from evil, God would not bring the disaster.
passages.original: אוּלַ֣י יִשְׁמְע֔וּ וְיָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֑ה וְנִחַמְתִּ֣י אֶל־ הָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י חֹשֵׁב֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘If you do not listen to Me and walk in My law, which I have set before you, and if you do not listen to the words of My servants the prophets, whom I have sent you again and again even though you did not listen, then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make this city an object of cursing among all the nations of the earth.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah at the beginning of Jehoiakim’s reign.
Jehoiakim was the son of Josiah.
Josiah was king of Judah.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message for the people.
The LORD said, “Tell the people this.”
The LORD said, “If you do not listen to Me, I will act.”
The LORD said, “I gave you My law.”
The LORD said, “I set My law before you.”
The LORD said, “You must walk in My law.”
The LORD said, “You must listen to the words of My servants.”
The LORD said, “My servants are the prophets.”
The LORD said, “I have sent My prophets to you many times.”
The LORD said, “You did not listen to My prophets.”
The LORD said, “If you do not listen, I will make this house like Shiloh.”
The LORD said, “I will make this city a curse among all the nations of the earth.”
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־ לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔י לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹרָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃ לִשְׁמֹ֗עַ עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֨י עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁלֵ֣חַ אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹ֖חַ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃ וְנָתַתִּ֛י אֶת־ הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה כְּשִׁלֹ֑ה וְאֶת־ הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאתָה אֶתֵּ֣ן לִקְלָלָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

passages.text: Now the priests and prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD, and as soon as he had finished telling all the people everything the LORD had commanded him to say, the priests and prophets and all the people seized him, shouting, “You must surely die!
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
He spoke in the house of the LORD.
The priests, the prophets, and all the people were there.
They heard Jeremiah speak these words.
Jeremiah finished saying everything the LORD had commanded him to say to all the people.
Then the priests, the prophets, and all the people seized Jeremiah.
They said, “You must surely die!”
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֛וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְהַנְּבִאִ֖ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֑ם אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ לְדַבֵּר֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיִּתְפְּשׂ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַנְּבִאִ֛ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֥ם לֵאמֹ֖ר מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃

passages.text: How dare you prophesy in the name of the LORD that this house will become like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted!” And all the people assembled against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The people spoke to Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
They said, “You prophesied in the name of the LORD.
You said this house will become like Shiloh.
You said this city will become empty and without people.
Why did you say these things?”
All the people gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
passages.original: מַדּוּעַ֩ נִבֵּ֨יתָ בְשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר כְּשִׁלוֹ֙ יִֽהְיֶה֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה וְהָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את תֶּחֱרַ֖ב מֵאֵ֣ין יוֹשֵׁ֑ב וַיִּקָּהֵ֧ל כָּל־ הָעָ֛ם אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: When the officials of Judah heard these things, they went up from the king’s palace to the house of the LORD and sat there at the entrance of the New Gate.
passages.sermon:
The officials of Judah heard these things.
They left the king’s palace.
They went to the house of the LORD.
They sat at the entrance of the New Gate.
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ׀ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיַּעֲל֥וּ מִבֵּית־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּֽשְׁב֛וּ בְּפֶ֥תַח שַֽׁעַר־ יְהוָ֖ה הֶחָדָֽשׁ׃ס

passages.text: Then the priests and prophets said to the officials and all the people, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your own ears!”
passages.sermon:
The priests and the prophets spoke.
They spoke to the officials.
They spoke to all the people.
They said, "This man deserves the death penalty.
He has prophesied against this city.
You have heard his words with your own ears."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְהַנְּבִאִים֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׂרִ֔ים וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּט־ מָ֙וֶת֙ לָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֤י נִבָּא֙ אֶל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people, “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
He spoke to all the officials of Judah.
He spoke to all the people of Judah.
Jeremiah said these words to them.
The LORD sent me.
The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house.
The LORD sent me to prophesy against this city.
I spoke all the words you have heard.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֔ים וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֗נִי לְהִנָּבֵ֞א אֶל־ הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ וְאֶל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃

passages.text: So now, correct your ways and deeds, and obey the voice of the LORD your God, so that He might relent of the disaster He has pronounced against you.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah spoke to the officials and all the people.
He told them what the LORD had sent him to say.
He said, “Now change your ways.
Change your actions.
Obey the voice of the LORD your God.
If you do this, the LORD may turn away from the disaster He has spoken against you.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֵיטִ֤יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶם֙ וּמַ֣עַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְשִׁמְע֕וּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְיִנָּחֵ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: As for me, here I am in your hands; do to me what you think is good and right.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah spoke to the officials and all the people.
He said, “I am in your hands.
You have power over me.
Do to me what you think is good.
Do what you think is right.”
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֖י הִנְנִ֣י בְיֶדְכֶ֑ם עֲשׂוּ־ לִ֛י כַּטּ֥וֹב וְכַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood upon yourselves, upon this city, and upon its residents; for truly the LORD has sent me to speak all these words in your hearing.”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah is a prophet sent by the LORD.
He speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
He warns them about their actions.
He says, “Know this for certain.
If you kill me, you will make yourselves guilty of shedding innocent blood.
You will bring this guilt on yourselves.
You will bring this guilt on this city.
You will bring this guilt on all who live here.
The LORD truly sent me to you.
He sent me to speak all these words in your hearing.”
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אִם־ מְמִתִ֣ים אַתֶּם֮ אֹתִי֒ כִּי־ דָ֣ם נָקִ֗י אַתֶּם֙ נֹתְנִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֶל־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את וְאֶל־ יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י בֶאֱמֶ֗ת שְׁלָחַ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְדַבֵּר֙ בְּאָזְנֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס

passages.text: Then the officials and all the people told the priests and prophets, “This man is not worthy of death, for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God!”
passages.sermon:
The officials spoke.
All the people spoke.
They spoke to the priests.
They spoke to the prophets.
They said, “This man is not guilty of a crime deserving death.
He has spoken to us.
He spoke in the name of the LORD our God.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְכָל־ הָעָ֔ם אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְאֶל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים אֵין־ לָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ מִשְׁפַּט־ מָ֔וֶת כִּ֗י בְּשֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Some of the elders of the land stood up and said to the whole assembly of the people, “Micah the Moreshite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and told all the people of Judah that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.’
passages.sermon:
Some elders of the land stood up.
They spoke to all the people gathered there.
They said, “Micah was a prophet from Moresheth.
Micah prophesied during the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah.
Micah spoke to all the people of Judah.
He said, ‘This is what the LORD of Hosts says.
Zion will be plowed like a field.
Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble.
The temple mount will become a wooded ridge.’”
passages.original: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִזִּקְנֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶל־ כָּל־ קְהַ֥ל הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ מִיכָיָה הַמּ֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔י הָיָ֣ה נִבָּ֔א בִּימֵ֖י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ כָּל־ עַם֩ יְהוּדָ֨ה לֵאמֹ֜ר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת צִיּ֞וֹן שָׂדֶ֤ה תֵֽחָרֵשׁ֙ וִירוּשָׁלַ֙יִם֙ עִיִּ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְהַ֥ר הַבַּ֖יִת לְבָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר׃

passages.text: Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did Hezekiah not fear the LORD and seek His favor, and did not the LORD relent of the disaster He had pronounced against them? But we are about to bring great harm on ourselves!”
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was king of Judah.
All the people of Judah lived under his rule.
Micah prophesied during Hezekiah’s time.
Did Hezekiah or anyone in Judah put Micah to death?
Hezekiah did not kill Micah.
Hezekiah feared the LORD.
Hezekiah sought the LORD’s favor.
The LORD had spoken about bringing disaster on Judah.
The LORD changed His mind and did not bring the disaster.
Now we are about to do great harm to ourselves.
passages.original: הֶהָמֵ֣ת הֱ֠מִתֻהוּ חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֗ה הֲלֹא֮ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־ יְהוָה֒ וַיְחַל֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים רָעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה עַל־ נַפְשׁוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Now there was another man prophesying in the name of the LORD, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim. He prophesied against this city and against this land the same things that Jeremiah did.
passages.sermon:
Uriah was a man.
He was the son of Shemaiah.
He came from Kiriath-jearim.
Uriah prophesied in the name of the LORD.
He spoke against this city.
He spoke against this land.
His words were the same as Jeremiah’s words.
passages.original: וְגַם־ אִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֤ה מִתְנַבֵּא֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֽוּרִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בֶּֽן־ שְׁמַעְיָ֔הוּ מִקִּרְיַ֖ת הַיְּעָרִ֑ים וַיִּנָּבֵ֞א עַל־ הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את כְּכֹ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃

passages.text: King Jehoiakim and all his mighty men and officials heard his words, and the king sought to put him to death. But when Uriah found out about it, he fled in fear and went to Egypt.
passages.sermon:
King Jehoiakim ruled Judah.
He had many mighty men.
He had many officials.
Uriah prophesied in the name of the LORD.
King Jehoiakim, his mighty men, and his officials heard Uriah’s words.
The king wanted to put Uriah to death.
Uriah heard about the king’s plan.
Uriah became afraid.
Uriah fled.
Uriah went to Egypt.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ יְ֠הוֹיָקִים וְכָל־ גִּבּוֹרָ֤יו וְכָל־ הַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶת־ דְּבָרָ֔יו וַיְבַקֵּ֥שׁ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הֲמִית֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אוּרִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וַיִּרָ֔א וַיִּבְרַ֖ח וַיָּבֹ֥א מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Then King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt: Elnathan son of Achbor along with some other men.
passages.sermon:
King Jehoiakim was the king of Judah.
King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt.
He sent Elnathan son of Achbor.
He also sent other men with Elnathan.
They all went to Egypt.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֛ים אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יִם אֵ֣ת אֶלְנָתָ֧ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּ֛וֹר וַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אִתּ֖וֹ אֶל־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him put to the sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people.
passages.sermon:
Uriah was a prophet.
Men brought Uriah out of Egypt.
They took Uriah to King Jehoiakim.
King Jehoiakim killed Uriah with a sword.
They threw Uriah’s body into the burial place of the common people.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ אוּרִיָּ֜הוּ מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וַיְבִאֻ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֔ים וַיַּכֵּ֖הוּ בֶּחָ֑רֶב וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת־ נִבְלָת֔וֹ אֶל־ קִבְרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah, so he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.
passages.sermon:
Ahikam was the son of Shaphan.
Ahikam supported Jeremiah.
The people wanted to kill Jeremiah.
Ahikam did not let the people take Jeremiah.
Ahikam kept Jeremiah safe from death.
passages.original: אַ֗ךְ יַ֚ד אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־ שָׁפָ֔ן הָיְתָ֖ה אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ לְבִלְתִּ֛י תֵּת־ אֹת֥וֹ בְיַד־ הָעָ֖ם לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃פ
